smoke.purpose: One LUCI identity-stage transport/schema/source-support smoke; does not prove scientific recovery

luci.purpose: Seven source windows, three stages each; original LUCI remains development/regression

holdout.purpose: Frozen spacesuit wire-break investigation, at most five fully staged windows. If document/budget exceeds capacity, report incomplete coverage; do not silently add calls or tune the contract.

cost_usd: UNKNOWN. Account pricing/credits are not recorded and failed-call billing was incomplete. Timeout calls reserve UTF-8 input+max output as an upper token bound; no zero-cost assertion. No request to provider made for pricing.
acceptance_requirements: First smoke must produce grounded identity/source support; a syntax-only or empty result does not authorize further scientific success claims
Source adjudicate recovered versus omitted investigations/groups/runs/quantities/conditions/conclusions, epistemic role and cross-section scope against original text/tables
Count documentary/planned rows and cited/derived results as negatives; require zero critical false source/run/role assignments
Report precision/recall denominators and omissions/unresolveds rather than treating schema or text coverage as science
Freeze final responses and human adjudication receipts; no prompt/schema/ontology tuning from the final holdout
No approval, publication or ontology activation. Phase 1 remains incomplete until the original scientific acceptance criteria pass
authorization: Renewed explicit authorization is required before --execute. --authorization-ref records that user authorization; the flag itself does not create it.
